identity.title: What a ShortsOS pilot involves: a workflow operated by the ShortsOS team
identity.description: A ShortsOS pilot is operated by the ShortsOS team; its one real run went from source video to a reviewed, live Instagram Reel, and it is not open to everyone.

data.text: Before you commit time to any production partner, you want to know who does the work and what you are actually buying. A ShortsOS pilot is operated by the ShortsOS team, and the workflow is not generally or instantly available to anyone who asks.

In a ShortsOS pilot, the ShortsOS team operates the workflow; the one real run completed so far went from source video and render, through human review, to a live Instagram Reel with a captured publication permalink. The review step before publication is a mandatory human checkpoint. Customers do not link their own Instagram account or publish directly through this workflow.

For pilots, the ShortsOS team operates the workflow on the customer's behalf, from production through review to publication. In the one real run so far, publication went through a single Instagram account bound to the operating team. That run started from source video, went through a render and a human review, and ended with a live Instagram Reel whose permalink was captured. The workflow is not open for anyone to start alone: it runs as a pilot operated by the team.

ShortsOS does not offer this workflow as a generally or instantly available product. A pilot does not include linking your own Instagram account, and it does not let a customer publish directly. It also carries no proof of repeated volume: what has been shown is one documented real run. No pilot comes with a promise of creative quality, performance or virality. If a vendor promises you more than it can show, that gap is worth naming before any work starts.
